params.prompt: Vertical 4:5 marketing composition for a premium app. Position a large smartphone on the RIGHT side of the frame so its center sits around 72 percent of the width; the ENTIRE phone is fully visible with comfortable margin from the top, right and bottom edges — do NOT crop the phone. The phone screen shows the provided UNIQN logo image as a full-screen app splash: the gold unicorn emblem centered on a black screen, displayed cleanly and exactly as given — do not alter or redraw it. The LEFT 45 percent of the frame must be clean empty negative space: a smooth dark near-black to deep gold gradient with only very subtle soft bokeh, absolutely NO objects, chips, cards, or text on the left half. Place a few stacked gold poker chips and one or two playing cards ONLY in the bottom-right corner near the base of the phone. Black and Gold premium aesthetic, warm gold rim light. NO people, no hands, NO extra text anywhere. Photorealistic, cinematic, high detail.
